description: Free. Fetch /api/agents/registry/<id> (current manifest) or /api/agents/registry/<id>/v/<n> (immutable version), then verify it OFFLINE: manifest_id recomputed with JCS, ML-DSA-65 signature checked — against the manifest's embedded key ONLY if that key equals the agent's CURRENT key reported by the registry/node (…/passport), otherwise reported as key_not_current/rotated. Returns { manifest, ok, verdict (current|not_current), signature_ok, passport_valid, agent_active, registry_verification (key_status, agent_status, passport_valid), offline { ok, checks[] }, trust }. ok = signature_ok && passport_valid && agent_active; anything else is an error with not_ok_because[] (a Destroyed agent is never ok).

version.description: Specific version (immutable). Omit for the current manifest.

name: get_agent_manifest
title: Fetch an agent's signed manifest (current or a specific version)
